Xiao Hua says: "The design of this exam is really difficult, I can only get about half right." Xiao Ming nods and says: "Yes, I also find it very difficult." At this time, their classmate Xiao Li comes over and interrupts: "I hear that someone in the class scores very low on the exam, even fails, it really is embarrassing."
